items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Chick Webb, boy, he had a tough band, and tough arrangements.

ctx.x: Right. We'd lose all the time. In fact, Duke Ellington even lost. Chick Webb, boy, he had a tough band, and tough arrangements. Oh, man. Boy, he had a whole band -- our bandstand would be jumping. And we wouldn't even be playing.
